resources.string: Choose a server or import a configuration file to connect.
Optional. A provider gives you access to its servers. It cannot change your identity, contacts or privacy settings.
Service removed. Remote revocation may be unknown.
Access paused. Choose your server again to continue.
Browser sign-in is unavailable in this build. A verified application registration is required.
No servers are available yet. Ask the provider for access.
Remove local access for %1$s, even when offline. This stops its active connection. Account deletion and remote revocation are separate.
This provider grants access only to its infrastructure. Browser sign-in uses the issuer you accept here.
I accept this provider and issuer.
Sign in to get a server
This app suggests %1$s. You sign in at %2$s in your browser, so Ito never sees your password.
Opens %1$s in your browser. Your password stays there.
Your account does not include this server.
The provider is unavailable. Try again later.
The server list is out of date or this phone\'s time could not be confirmed. Check the date and time, then try again.
This provider uses a sign-in that this version of Ito does not support.
Ito could not read or save provider data on this phone.
Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
The provider\'s details did not match. Remove it and add it again.
Android has not confirmed Ito\'s sign-in link yet. Make sure “Open supported links” is on for Ito, then try again in a few minutes. If it keeps failing, reinstall Ito.
Access ended. Choose your server again.
Sign-in took too long. Try again.
Another change is still in progress. Try again shortly.
This is the server address, not proof of where traffic leaves.
Complete sign-in in your browser, or cancel and start again.
